description: The platform's person and company brief for one lead: who they are now (LinkedIn read today), their role at the company, what they post about, and their company (what it sells, customers, size, funding, open roles, key points, news, its posts, competitors). Takes an email, the person's LinkedIn URL, a company domain or the company's LinkedIn URL (any one is enough; more make it surer). Costs 22 credits when it finds something and takes about a minute; the same lookup is kept for 24 hours at no charge. For a brief, a summary or 'who is' a lead.

refresh.description: Only for an explicit request to look it up again.
